comments.body_html:
I helped someone with a similar issue a while ago, you may have an unavailable voice currently set on your profile.

If the voice selector in the game’s audio settings works, try using that to change to one of the defaults for your faction then restart the game and try the mod’s dropdown again. If that doesn’t work, I can take a look at your profile if you upload it pastebin or Github Gist or ping me with it in the SPT discord.
